verdict.rationale: Jeeves publishes an llms.txt at tryjeeves.com/llms.txt. Its content, as evidenced, is a product and marketing summary that briefly mentions the API platform. The developer docs portal returned 404 for llms.txt and for every probed OpenAPI path, so an agent cannot be pointed at machine-readable developer docs there. Missing for 10: llms.txt on the developer docs host, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, evidence that the llms.txt indexes API or developer documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
